summary: feat(settings): update reset password start page copy for passkeys
description:
## Because

- The reset password start page offered no way to sign in with Google, Apple, or a passkey instead of a reset.
- The old footer link and its passkey props did not match the new copy.

## This pull request

- Changes the heading to "Forgot your password?" and rewrites the body copy, with new FTL IDs, in `en.ftl` and `index.tsx`.
- Adds a body link to the email-first sign-in page. It keeps the query params.
- Passes the typed email as `state.prefillEmail` when the email is valid, as the removed footer did. It sends nothing for an invalid email. This is the round 2 change.
- Moves the data recovery warning below Continue as small print (`text-grey-500`) with a "Learn more" support link.
- Removes the footer sign-in link (`LinkRememberPassword`), the `showPasskeyOption` prop, and the footer Glean events.
- Adds Glean auto-click ids to the two new links.
- Updates the unit tests, `mocks.tsx`, and the functional page object. Adds a functional test for the body link.

## Issue that this pull request solves

Closes: https://mozilla-hub.atlassian.net/browse/FXA-13258
